F0 has been consistently bidding 0.1117-0.1118, which is *below* their stated cost of capital of... wait, F0 bids 0.1117 but their cost must be at or below that. F0 is winning sometimes when they bid lower than F3.

So I (F3) am NOT winning - F0 is winning. I should consider: if I bid lower than F0 (below 0.1117), I win but get paid F0's bid ~0.1117, which is below my cost of capital 0.1126 - that loses money.

So I cannot profitably undercut F0. My best move is to bid my true cost 0.1126 and hope F0 bids above that somehow, or accept losing.
